Joanna Kaczmarek

move.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
move.body:
Dear Ms Aigner,

Thank you for your quote for the stainless pump shaft SH-220.

We have reviewed your terms and would like to propose two packages:

- Option A: EUR 15.05 per unit, payment 60 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP Hollerau
- Option B: EUR 14.90 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP Hollerau

Option A has a slightly higher price with longer payment terms. Option B has a lower price with faster payment. Both have a lead time of 35 days, with delivery to our site in Hollerau.

Please let us know which package suits you better, or which points you would like to discuss.

Could you send us your cost breakdown for this part?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
move.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you very much for your offer for the stainless pump shaft SH-220 and for your kind words about a long-term partnership. We value that, and we would also like to build a fair and lasting relationship with Demo Machining.

To find a basis that works well for both sides, we would like to propose three options:

- Option A: EUR 14.08 per unit, payment 60 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP Hollerau
- Option B: EUR 13.48 per unit, payment 60 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW
- Option C: EUR 13.94 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP Hollerau

Option C gives you faster payment, and Option B leaves the transport with us. Please choose whichever suits you best.

Could you send us your cost breakdown for this part?

We look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We welcome your proposal of 14-day payment terms, which enables us to support your requested 35-day lead time.

Our current Angebot is a price of €16.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP. Alternatively, with delivery EXW: €15.80 per unit. To provide you with the most competitive rate possible, we propose maintaining the delivery terms at EXW instead of DAP.

Please note that material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Any further step needs approval from our management. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.body:
Dear Ms Aigner,

Thank you for your reply, for moving on the price, and for sending the cost breakdown. We note that the 14-day payment terms suit you.

We have reviewed your offer and have moved toward you on price. We propose two packages for the SH-220 shaft:

- Option A: EUR 15.42 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, delivery DAP Hollerau.
- Option B: EUR 14.83 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, delivery EXW.

Both keep the payment and lead-time terms you confirmed. They differ only in price and delivery terms. Please let us know which package works better for you.

Is there a variant of the part or the process that would be cheaper for both of us?

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Hallo, thanks for moving up on the price. I can drop to 15.60 EUR for the DAP package with the 14 days payment. We can offer an alternative package with a price of €15.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP.

My guys will check your technical question about a cheaper variant. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

move.text:
Dear partner,
Many thanks for your reply; we really appreciate the chance to work with you.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €15.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery EXW.
To be fully transparent with you:
We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We have noted your reference to the competing offer, though our pricing reflects the reliability and quality we bring to this partnership.
The cheaper variant we mentioned in our previous message is the EXW delivery option, which excludes transport costs.
In response to your updated proposal, we can offer a revised price of EUR 15.70 per unit for the EXW package, keeping the 14-day payment and 35-day lead time.
Our management has approved a further step.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL.
Our whole team is ready, and we will do everything to make you a satisfied customer.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
